lines: The countless masses of humanity.
False bravado, inner images, inhuman—like a monster.
A sincere, open heart houses life.
The rest are empty shells, hollow people.
Gathered expectations, an unequal life.
Lacking talent, grand illusion, the extraordinary.
Parents full of spite, equally without personality.
Following memories, because I have no place.
Don’t just cry in the gap of a dream.
I know what face I should wear.
But still, answer me.
Purify the darkness, purify the darkness.
When night’s veil falls, it’s the signal.
Facing each other, the loop circles.
Spit out the nonsense.
Don’t stop yet, don’t stop yet.
The true self born in a city wiser than any.
Now I can only yearn, imagining my cursed future.
Run and fall.
Holding the unending pain.
The world is waiting.
For this instant.
Ah, exhilarating feeling, future—take it back.
The penalty of that obedient, flawed obedience.
A steady gaze, I need normalcy.
Still unable to raise my voice.
Ah, a puppet procession of a hundred night demons, oathless.
Ah, to the abyss’s end without sorcery.
Paradise, rebirth, reality, flaws, all calm.
Don’t throw away your life.
Shine through the fragility of words.
I don’t know what face to wear.
Now just answer me.
Preach the five virtues, preach the five virtues.
Ideas that weave uncertain voices.
Canceling out, the loop turns.
Beyond that, now, the hand that rises.
Just keep chasing, just keep chasing.
I wish to be stronger than anyone.
Even your fate is just now.
Sinking deep, deep into the dim night’s depths.
Did I look awkward?
This is who I am now.
Just a corpse that can’t become anything—laugh.
I even stopped fleeing from everything before me.
Repeat the image, go beyond what I imagine.
Purify the darkness, purify the darkness.
When night’s veil falls, it’s the signal.
Facing each other, the loop circles.
Spit out the nonsense.
Don’t stop yet, don’t stop yet.
The true self born in a city wiser than any.
Now I can only yearn, imagining my cursed future.
Run and fall.
Holding the unending pain.
The world is waiting.
For this instant.
